product_overview: CyberFlow provides a read-only web dashboard for monitoring system health, activity, decisions, and model status in demo mode. It also offers a developer view for exploring system topology, tracing, and permitted artifact files, all within a browser-based operational interface.
core_goals: Review operational health, freshness, and activity indicators from a single dashboard
Inspect decision timelines, score trends, and filtered activity over selected time ranges
Switch into developer mode to explore the seven system views and node details
Open only whitelisted artifact files in a read-only viewer
Review the active learning model, threshold, and comparison evidence
Log in as a reader to access the operational panel and confirm restricted access to developer views

features.name: System health and ingestion pulse
features.description: Lets users monitor service health, capture activity, decisions, dataset accumulation, and feed freshness from the operational dashboard.
user_flows: Navigate to / -> Read the health banner and KPI cards -> Observe updated metrics after a polling cycle -> Distinguish missing data from zero activity

features.name: Activity, decisions and action timeline
features.description: Lets users review recent activity, decision outcomes, and score trends over selected periods with filtering.
user_flows: Navigate to / -> Select the one-hour activity range -> Inspect the recent action timeline and score chart -> Switch to the 24-hour range -> Filter decisions by action -> Filter decisions by entity IP -> Review the resulting decision rows

features.name: Developer mode and seven system views
features.description: Lets users reveal advanced operational views, switch among topology screens, inspect nodes, and use the guided tour.
user_flows: Navigate to / -> Toggle developer mode -> Switch to the operational view -> Switch to the network view -> Switch to the decision view -> Switch to the response view -> Switch to the training view -> Switch to the method view -> Switch to the validation view -> Select a node and inspect its detail panel -> Start the guided tour -> Close the guided tour

features.name: Read-only code viewer
features.description: Lets users open permitted artifact files from the developer area in a read-only modal and verify that outside-whitelist paths are denied.
user_flows: Navigate to / -> Toggle developer mode -> Open the file browser -> Select a component and a file -> Open the content viewer -> Close the content viewer with Escape -> Attempt to open a path outside the whitelist -> See the request denied

features.name: Model, learning and comparison
features.description: Lets users inspect the active detector, threshold, feature values, drift indicators, learning history, and the scoped comparison evidence.
user_flows: Navigate to / -> Read the active detector and threshold -> Inspect variable values and drift indicators -> Review the learning history -> Open the comparison view -> Review the comparison limitations and source evidence

features.name: Login and reader role
features.description: Lets users sign in through the secure login page, access the operational panel as a reader, confirm developer restrictions, and log out.
user_flows: Navigate to /login -> Fill in username and password -> Submit the login form -> See the operational panel as a reader -> Confirm developer views are unavailable -> Log out

tech_stack: Python 3.14 server using http.server and ssl from the standard library
Embedded HTML, CSS and vanilla JavaScript served by scripts/engine/dashboard.py
JSON APIs with polling and server-rendered role-specific HTML
Chromium-compatible responsive interface with SVG charts and diagrams

routes.description: CyberFlow read-only dashboard, operational view for lector and admin; --demo makes it accessible without login using example data
Login form for the live HTTPS deployment; not used in --demo mode

known_limitations.issue: This run targets --demo on localhost:8799, not authenticated Sensor1; demo figures are examples and live login cannot be verified here
known_limitations.impact: Tests must not be cited as evidence of live detection or role-restricted production access

known_limitations.issue: Heuristic-only LIMIT can leave the health banner saying Todo operando con normalidad
known_limitations.impact: Operator may overlook an active response when model alert counters remain zero

known_limitations.issue: Mobile layout at 390 CSS pixels expands to 574 pixels in a local Chromium run
known_limitations.location: scripts/engine/dashboard.py responsive CSS shell and side navigation
known_limitations.impact: Browser scales down content and mobile text becomes hard to read

known_limitations.issue: Nonzero cumulative kernel drop counters are treated as current drops
known_limitations.impact: Historical drops can continue to show a warning after capture recovers
